versions.subject: Fix Further FPs Found In Testing (#4564)
versions.detection:
selection:
    AccessList|contains:
        - '%%4417' # WriteData
        - '%%4418' # AppendData
    EventID:
        - 4656 # A handle to an object was requested.
        - 4663 # An attempt was made to access an object.
    ObjectName|contains: '\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Exclusions\'
condition: selection
versions.spl: AccessList IN ("*%%4417*", "*%%4418*") EventID IN (4656, 4663) ObjectName="*\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Exclusions\\*"
